en.title: Sum of Subarray Regions
en.description:
The region of each position is the longest contiguous interval that contains the position and in which its height is still the maximum; equal heights still count as the maximum.

The standard input/output conventions and constraints added by this site are described under "Input".
en.output: Output the sum of the lengths of all regions.
en.explanation: Use a monotonic stack to find the nearest strictly taller height on the left and on the right.
hints: Use a monotonic stack to find the nearest strictly taller height on the left and on the right.
